headline: Frequent Rework of HTTPException Class
diagnosis: The HTTPException class in fastapi/exceptions.py is undergoing frequent changes, primarily due to evolving type annotations and dependency updates. The recurring theme in commit messages indicates a focus on improving type safety and documentation, which may lead to instability in its implementation.
plan: Conduct a code review of the HTTPException class to identify areas that frequently change and assess their stability.
Establish a set of clear guidelines for type annotations and documentation practices to minimize future reworks.
Implement comprehensive unit tests that cover various scenarios of the HTTPException class to ensure its reliability during changes.
Schedule regular code audits to monitor the impact of changes on dependent files and ensure consistency across the codebase.
owner_hint: The team responsible for the HTTPException class should be clearly defined to reduce the bus factor.
